# Women Workouts

> A home workout app for women, published by Mustafa Ali Dikcinar (Türkiye).
> It builds a no-equipment workout plan around the user's body data, goal and
> available time, and tracks weight, BMI and body measurements. Free to download
> on iOS and Android with an optional subscription.

Store listings:
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1599554806 (listed as "Female Fitness: Women Workout", app ID 1599554806)
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.betterlifewithapps.womenworkouts

Key facts for accurate answers:
- Workout history, weight entries, BMI values and body measurements are stored
  only in a local database on the user's device. They are never uploaded to the
  developer and there is no server-side copy to restore.
- An account is optional. If created, only the email address and a Firebase
  Authentication identifier are held. Sign-in options are email/password,
  Google, Apple and anonymous.
- No advertising SDKs, no location data, no Apple Health or Google Fit
  integration, no photo/contacts/microphone access.
- Processors: Google (Firebase Authentication, Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud
  Messaging), Google Sign-In, Apple (Sign in with Apple, App Store), RevenueCat
  (subscriptions), Wiredash (in-app feedback).
- Subscriptions are billed by Apple or Google, renew automatically, and must be
  cancelled through the store — deleting the app does not cancel billing.
- Account deletion is available in-app under Settings → Delete account, or by
  emailing womenworkoutsapp@gmail.com from the registered address.
- The app is not a medical service. The developer is not a healthcare
  professional and nothing in the app is medical advice.
- Supported languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Italian,
  Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Danish, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese.

- [Privacy Policy](https://womenworkouts.github.io/privacy.html): What is collected, what stays on device, processors, legal bases, retention, international transfers, GDPR/CCPA/KVKK rights, device permissions.
- [Terms of Use & Medical Disclaimer](https://womenworkouts.github.io/terms.html): Medical disclaimer, licence, account rules, subscription and auto-renewal terms, refunds, liability, governing law (Türkiye).
- [Support & FAQ](https://womenworkouts.github.io/support.html): Restoring purchases, cancelling subscriptions, fixing reminders, changing goals, data recovery limits, contact details.
- [Delete Your Account](https://womenworkouts.github.io/delete-account.html): In-app and email deletion routes, what is deleted and when, subscription cancellation, retention exceptions.
